newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda shares jump on strong forecast.
newsitem.headline: Honda shares jump on strong forecast.

text.p: Shares in Honda Motor Co Ltd jumped on Tuesday morning, as the firm's strong earnings forecast attracted institutional investors, traders said.
Honda's share price gained 50 yen to end the morning session at 2,920 yen. Volume was 1.933 million shares.
"Investors, who have been sidelined in general, seemed to nibble at shares of those companies backed by solid earnings, such as Honda," said a trader at a major Japanese securities house.

Satoshi Aoki, the director in charge of Honda's finance department, said last Friday that Honda expected group operating profits to hit 356 billion yen in the current fiscal year which ends March 1997.
Honda's actual group operating profit in 1995/96 was 143.6 billion yen, he said.
